import json, os, subprocess, sys, random, time
sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/tmp'); sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/submission'); sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace')
import gen
from verify import verify
env=dict(os.environ, PATH="/workspace/tmp/binlink", TMPDIR="/workspace/tmp", PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE="1")
fails=0
for seed in range(int(sys.argv[1]),int(sys.argv[2])):
    rng=random.Random(seed*7919+13)
    req=gen.make_request(seed,count=rng.randint(0,2),max_routes=6,max_tx=2,max_bursts=3,narrow=True)
    payload=json.dumps(req).encode()
    p=subprocess.run(["/usr/local/bin/python3","-B","/workspace/submission/main.py"],input=payload,
                     stdout=subprocess.PIPE,stderr=subprocess.PIPE,env=env)
    if p.returncode:
        print("seed",seed,"CRASH",p.stderr.decode()[-300:]); fails+=1; continue
    out=json.loads(p.stdout.decode())
    if "error" in out: print("seed",seed,"INVALID?"); fails+=1; continue
    try: verify(req,out,random.Random(seed))
    except AssertionError as e:
        print("seed",seed,"VERIFY FAIL",str(e)[:200]); fails+=1
        open('/workspace/tmp/fbfail.json','wb').write(payload)
print("fallback fuzz failures",fails)
EOF
python3 tmp/fuzzfallback.py 0 80 2>&1 | tail -4
